errors.text_span: etwa 750 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 1987
errors.evidence: The description states the value for the TSE line in 1987 is approximately 750 Euro, but the chart shows it starting above 800 Euro (around 820).

errors.text_span: etwa 600 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 2017
errors.evidence: The description states the final value for the TSE line in 2017 is approximately 600 Euro, but the chart shows it at approximately 500 Euro.

errors.text_span: Sie steigt zunächst leicht auf etwa 850 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 1989 an, bevor sie auf etwa 700 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 1991 abfällt.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly describes the trend for the TSE line. The chart shows a dip in 1989 and a sharp rise to a peak in 1991. The description reverses this, claiming a rise to 1989 and a fall to 1991.

errors.text_span: steigt sie erneut auf etwa 1000 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 2001 an
errors.evidence: The description claims a peak of 1000 Euro in 2001 for the TSE line. The chart shows the value in 2001 is much lower (around 820 Euro). The actual peaks are in 1991 and 2003 at just under 1000 Euro.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bis 2017 auf etwa 600 Euro pro Hektar ansteigt
errors.evidence: The description claims the TSE line rises to 600 Euro by 2017 after 2009. The chart shows the line fluctuating and ending at around 500 Euro in 2017, not rising to 600.

errors.text_span: etwa 550 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 1987
errors.evidence: The description states the starting value for the TSEC line in 1987 is approximately 550 Euro, but the chart shows it is clearly above 600 Euro (around 620).

errors.text_span: Sie steigt zunächst auf etwa 700 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 1989 an
errors.evidence: The description claims the TSEC line rises to a peak in 1989. The chart shows the peak is in 1988, followed by a sharp drop in 1989.

errors.text_span: bevor sie auf etwa 50 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 2013 abfällt
errors.evidence: The description states the TSEC line drops to 50 Euro in 2013. The chart shows this low point occurred in 2011, not 2013. In 2013, the value had recovered to over 100 Euro.

errors.text_span: etwa 500 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 2017

errors.evidence: The description claims the TSEB line rises to about 450 Euro in 2003. The chart shows it peaks at a much higher value, around 570 Euro, in 2003.

errors.text_span: und dann bis 2017 auf etwa 500 Euro pro Hektar ansteigt
